bagPolicy.summary: Electric Zoo has not announced a current edition or active bag policy. Do not apply unrelated Central Park Zoo rules or historical festival rules to a future event.
bagPolicy.note: Confirm any future edition and its entry policy through the festival's official channel before purchasing tickets or travelling.

parking.note: No current festival venue or transportation plan is published. Randall's Island or zoo maps from past events are not current festival parking guidance.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Electric Zoo's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: No current festival food-and-beverage program is published. Check the festival's official channel if a new edition is announced.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Electric Zoo, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Electric Zoo's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Electric Zoo. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Electric Zoo. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
